Facility.title: Facility
Facility.description: Synthetic clinical facility metadata used to scope intake submissions and staff access. Provisioned exclusively via Firebase Console (Option 2B).

id.description: Facility document identifier matching the document ID.

publicCode.description: Public intake routing code for the facility.

active.description: Whether the facility currently accepts intakes and active staff sessions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the facility record was created.

StaffProfile.title: StaffProfile
StaffProfile.description: Provisioned clinical staff authorization profile keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Provisioned exclusively via Firebase Console (Option 2B); read-only to the authenticated owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Staff display name shown in review headers and audit records.

role.description: Clinical or administrative role within assigned facilities.

facilityIds.description: Bounded list (1-10) of authorised facility IDs.

active.description: Whether the staff account is currently authorised for access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the staff profile was provisioned.

IntakeRecord.title: IntakeRecord
IntakeRecord.description: Patient-confirmed clinical intake record with immutable original narrative, separate AI draft fields (staff-triggered only per Option 1B), and staff-controlled workflow state.

id.description: Intake document identifier matching the document ID.

facilityId.description: Authoritative owning facility identifier (immutable after creation).

patientDisplayName.description: Optional synthetic patient name or alias.

age.description: Optional patient age in years (0-120); never required for submission.

inputMode.description: Input method used by the patient.

transcriptionStatus.description: Outcome of voice transcription if voice input was attempted.

transcriptRaw.description: Optional raw voice transcript prior to patient edits (immutable after creation).

confirmedNarrative.description: Patient-confirmed statement in their own words (immutable after creation).

aiStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the optional AI intake brief draft.

aiBrief.description: Non-authoritative structured AI intake brief validated server-side and persisted only via an authenticated staff session (Option 1B).

aiBriefProvenance.description: Server-side provenance metadata (model, schemaVersion, verifiedByServer, contentHash) for aiBrief.

aiErrorCode.description: Safe error code recorded when AI extraction fails.

staffReviewStatus.description: Staff verification status of the intake brief.

staffBrief.description: Staff-confirmed or corrected intake brief stored separately from aiBrief.

staffCorrectionNote.description: Optional staff note explaining corrections made to the AI draft.

priorityReason.description: Staff reason recorded when assigning or changing workflow priority.

workflowStatus.description: Intake review workflow state (not clinical disposition).

idempotencyKey.description: Client submission idempotency key (immutable after creation).

initialAuditEventId.description: Document ID of the atomic intake_created audit event.

lastAuditEventId.description: Document ID of the most recent atomic audit event.

reviewedByUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the staff member who last reviewed the brief.

reviewedAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent staff brief review.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the intake was submitted (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest update.

AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent
AuditEvent.description: Append-only immutable audit event distinguishing patient, staff, and system actors (Decision D-007).

id.description: Audit event identifier matching the document ID.

facilityId.description: Facility ID matching the parent intake record.

intakeId.description: Parent intake ID matching the path variable.

actorType.description: Explicit actor category preventing non-staff actions from masquerading as clinicians.

actorUid.description: Staff Firebase Auth UID (required for staff actors; forbidden for patient/system actors).

actorRole.description: Staff role (required for staff actors; forbidden for patient/system actors).

actorDisplayName.description: Optional display label for the actor.

action.description: Lifecycle or staff workflow action recorded by this event.

reason.description: Staff reason (mandatory on priority changes and overrides).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the audit event was committed.

/facilities/{facilityId}.description: Active synthetic facility registry (public single-doc get only; console-provisioned).

/staff/{uid}.description: Provisioned clinical staff authorization records (owner-only single-doc get; console-provisioned).

/intakes/{intakeId}.description: Facility-scoped patient intakes (write-only public create with atomic patient audit; active facility staff read/action-updates only).

/intakes/{intakeId}/auditEvents/{eventId.description: Immutable append-only audit trail scoped to each intake and facility.
